# AMGF - Libertate Financiara

> AMGF este un ecosistem DeFi transparent construit pe reteaua Base (Ethereum L2), centrat pe tokenul $AMGF (ERC-20, contract 0x64bfE8A8C23b896ab810e2a051cC6E5F0C2ac765). Include un portofel non-custodial multi-chain, staking, airdrop manager, platforma educationala Learn-to-Earn si guvernanta DAO.

## Pagini principale

- [Pagina principala](https://amgf-finance.com/): prezentarea proiectului, tokenomics, roadmap, transparenta lichiditatii
- [Cartea Alba](https://amgf-finance.com/whitepaper.html): whitepaper complet v1.0 - misiune, tokenomics, guvernanta DAO, aspecte tehnice
- [Comunitate](https://amgf-finance.com/community.html): pagina comunitatii AMGF
- [Statistici Live](https://amgf-finance.com/stats.html): dashboard live cu pret, market cap si fonduri blocate

## Aplicatii din ecosistem

- [AMGF Wallet N.C.](https://wallet.amgf-finance.com): portofel non-custodial multi-chain
- [Airdrop Manager](https://airdrop.amgf-finance.com): campanii de airdrop
- [Staking Hub](https://staking.amgf-finance.com): staking $AMGF
- [AMGF Code App](https://code.amgf-finance.com): platforma de dezvoltare Build-to-Earn

## Date cheie

- Retea: Base (Coinbase Ethereum L2)
- Total supply: 1,000,000,000 $AMGF
